meta.name: Turn of the Tide
meta.description: When a boat loaded with cocaine sinks off his home island, Eduardo sees a risky but exciting opportunity to make money and fulfill impossible dreams.

videos.title: Storm
videos.overview: The lives of Eduardo, Silvia, Rafael and Carlinhos inevitably change when hundreds of kilos of cocaine sink off the coast near their small village.

videos.title: Supply and Demand
videos.overview: Eduardo and his friends start their new shipwrecked cocaine business, but the arrival of Inspector Frias to the village complicates their venture.

videos.title: Earth Shakes
videos.overview: An earthquake disturbs life in the village, but drug lord Monti is the one who turns things upside down as he tries to recover his missing cocaine.

videos.title: Loose Lips
videos.overview: The business finally takes off. Frias and Monti are neck and neck in the race to find the drugs, but an incident puts a new competitor on the track.

videos.title: No One Escapes from an Island
videos.overview: Eduardo and Rafael are missing. A reluctant Silvia moves in with her father, whose help is requested by Ian and Bruna when they receive a serious threat.

videos.title: The Swan Song
videos.overview: The friends find refuge in Joe's hiding place while they deal with a terrible loss, but they can't run away from their misfortunes for long.

videos.title: This Is Not America
videos.overview: When Joe draws up the ultimate plan for selling the drugs and escaping to the US, the friends fall apart and Eduardo's ambition is called into question.

meta.slogan: Where dreams are on the line.
